rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to introduce another option in everyday Cantonese.

example.english: Do you want rice, or alternatively noodles?
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 sik6 faan6 waak6 ze2 sik6 min6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when adding a further alternative after an option has already been mentioned.

example.english: We can go today, or alternatively go tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋今日去，又或者聽日先去都得。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 jau6 waak6 ze2 ting1 jat6 sin1 heoi3 dou1 dak1
